description: This file implements a class for writing source line and function information from PDB and PE files using DIA SDK and Windows APIs, primarily for debugging symbol generation.

classes.name: AutoImage
classes.description: Helper class to manage the lifetime of a loaded image, unloading it upon destruction.

methods.name: SetCodeFile
methods.description: Sets the code file path, ensuring consistency if already set.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Initializes DIA data source and loads symbol data from a specified file in a given format.

methods.name: PrintLines
methods.description: Outputs line number information for a given set of line numbers.

methods.name: PrintFunction
methods.description: Outputs function and associated line info for a given DIA symbol.

methods.name: PrintSourceFiles
methods.description: Outputs source file information from DIA symbols.

methods.name: PrintFunctions
methods.description: Outputs all function symbols, public symbols, and code blocks.

methods.name: PrintFrameDataUsingPDB
methods.description: Outputs frame data using DIA's frame data enumeration.

methods.name: PrintFrameDataUsingEXE
methods.description: Outputs frame data by parsing the PE image and unwind info.

methods.name: PrintFrameData
methods.description: Chooses between PDB and EXE methods to output frame data based on architecture.

methods.name: PrintCodePublicSymbol
methods.description: Outputs public symbols that are code addresses.

methods.name: PrintPDBInfo
methods.description: Outputs module information from the PDB session.

methods.name: PrintPEInfo
methods.description: Outputs PE file information such as code ID.

methods.name: wcstol_positive_strict
methods.description: Converts a string of digits to an integer, ensuring no overflow or invalid characters.

methods.name: FindPEFile
methods.description: Attempts to locate the PE file associated with the symbol session.

methods.name: GetSymbolFunctionName
methods.description: Retrieves and undecorates a function's name, extracting parameter size if possible.

methods.name: GetFunctionStackParamSize
methods.description: Calculates the size of stack parameters for a function based on debug symbols.

methods.name: WriteMap
methods.description: Outputs symbol and frame info to a file, including module, source, functions, and frame data.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Releases the DIA session.

methods.name: GetModuleInfo
methods.description: Retrieves module GUID, signature, and debug info.

methods.name: GetPEInfo
methods.description: Retrieves PE file info such as code ID and filename.

methods.name: UsesGUID
methods.description: Determines if the module uses a GUID or a signature for identification.
